summary_1line: Bhishma begins a tale of sage Chyavana’s extreme asceticism at the Ganga–Yamuna confluence, where fishermen accidentally drag him up with their net.

image_candidates.scene_text: At the confluence of the Ganga and Yamuna, the moss-covered sage Chyavana stands motionless in the rushing water like a wooden post.
Fishermen haul in a vast net from the river, revealing the green-bearded ascetic tangled among fish and shells.
The fishermen, shocked, fall prostrate with joined palms before the moss-covered sage lying among dying fish on the riverbank.
